verdict.rationale: Forter returns a fraud decision at checkout (forter-docs-1). The commerce extension lets merchants configure what happens on each decision, such as auto-invoice/capture on approval, through site preferences (forter-docs-18, forter-docs-34). Its MCP server mentions updating policies (forter-docs-9), and 3DS SDKs exist (forter-docs-31, forter-docs-32). This is decision-to-action mapping, not score-range thresholds the merchant can tune. Missing for 10: any evidence of a numeric risk score, merchant-adjustable score thresholds or ranges, an explicit review/step-up-3DS action tier tied to score bands, and independent corroboration.
